summary: This filing reports a strategic partnership announcement by Park Ha Biological Technology Co., Ltd., a foreign private issuer, regarding a joint development of an AI-driven ecosystem with Cloud Factory Technology Holdings. No financial terms, stake, or board recommendation are provided; the collaboration is non-binding and non-transactional. As a routine partnership disclosure without definitive terms or structural changes, it does not meet special-situation criteria. Filing on Form 6-K, equivalent to a US 8-K announcement. What to watch: any subsequent definitive agreements or material financial commitments that could trigger a reclassification.
